'''Vosdia Nooma''' was the main character in the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] play ''[[The Trickery of Vosdia Nooma]]''. The role was played by [[Chooru Delb]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
